name: Solis Minerals Ltd.
summary: Solis Minerals Ltd. specializes in identifying, acquiring, and developing sites containing mineral resources. The firm primarily targets copper deposits but also conducts exploration for other precious metals such as gold, silver, iron, and molybdenum. Its key assets include the Ilo Norte and Ilo Este copper projects, spanning approximately 9,500 hectares in southern Peru. Founded in 2005, the company was initially known as Westminster Resources Ltd. before rebranding to Solis Minerals Ltd. in July 2021. Its corporate headquarters are located in Vancouver, Canada.
